whatThisPluginAdds.text: Socials adds site-scoped registered and custom social profiles, shared follow and share defaults, and an explicit Block Library widget.

surfaceOutcome.text: Admins manage profiles and previews on the Socials page, then editors place follow or share links on selected pages. Visitors receive accessible links without social SDKs or tracking scripts.

developers.text: The network registry, public resolver contract, and typed render data keep profile validation separate from admin forms and public rendering.

teams.text: Teams can approve social profiles once per site, reuse them in follow blocks, and offer canonical page sharing without embedding third-party scripts.
